svg.aria-label: Enterprise AI Research Agent, a hand-built four-step RAG pipeline that refuses to answer instead of hallucinating.

g.text: Answers enterprise policy questions from a ChromaDB vector store and deliberately refuses to
answer instead of hallucinating. I skipped LangChain on purpose and hand-built a 4-step pipeline
(query understanding, retrieval, validation, generation) so every step stays explainable. Groq
LLaMA 3.1 handles generation, PostgreSQL keeps audit data, and a self-healing ingestion job
